instrumentation.oracle: The expected guard is exact HTTP 405 with the outdated-branch reason, target PR open/unmerged, and target file absent. Any accepted target merge is explicitly reported as TOCTOU OBSERVED; inconsistent or generic refusal is inconclusive.
instrumentation.interpretation: The final target merge commit contains the concurrent merge as an ancestor, so this test does not demonstrate loss of the concurrent change. It demonstrates that block_on_outdated_branch can be decided using stale CommitsBehind state. The test attaches no external proof and does not itself demonstrate acceptance of a proof bound to an earlier base.

mechanism: Capture the branch-row SHA in the same DB transaction as mergeability checks and pass it through API, web, and AutoMerge paths.
Compare the expected SHA with the fetched Git base; recompute actual divergence when block_on_outdated_branch applies instead of trusting cached CommitsBehind.
Require the built merge result to descend from the checked base and push with --force-with-lease against the expected base ref.

combined_selected_integration.source_test_version: The production patch and all three freshness scenarios passed before a final test-only assertion comparing the check-time expected base SHA was added; after that assertion, the post-fetch race passed alone, not as a full combined rerun.

limits: The full Forgejo repository suite was not run; the combined command selected merge-related API integration tests only.
A local cooperative/source guard does not create server-side atomicity against external writers or other hosts.
LFSPush runs before the Git lease push; a failed lease can leave uploaded unreferenced LFS objects. LFS was not tested.
AutoMerge deletes its schedule row before Merge; a CAS failure may leave the operation unqueued. This order is unchanged in the patch.
Manual-merge bookkeeping and pull-request-head update/rebase are separate paths; no full race coverage for web or every route is claimed.
The final isolated E2E emits some TestLogger FATAL teardown markers while go test exits 0; relevant AutoMerge logger markers were also observed on baseline.
